## Comprehensive SOY-POY Portal Codebase Exploration Report

### 1. EventEntity Fields (Current)

**File:** `/Users/masanao/Dev/soypoy-potal/src/domain/entities/event/index.ts`

Complete list of EventEntity fields:
- `id` (string) - Unique identifier
- `publicationStatus` (PublicationStatus) - Draft, Published, or Archived
- `title` (string) - Event title (required)
- `date` (string) - Date in YYYY-MM-DD format (required)
- `description` (string, optional) - Event description (supports Markdown with ## or ### headings)
- `thumbnail` (string | null, optional) - Cloudinary image URL
- `type` (EventType) - Event category (Art, Comedy, Dance, Design, Impro, Impro_Kanji, Movie, Music, Photo, Talk, Theater, Workshop, Other)
- `isPickup` (boolean) - Whether to display as pickup event
- `openTime` (string) - Door opening time in HH:mm format (required, defaults to "19:00")
- `startTime` (string) - Event start time in HH:mm format (required, defaults to "20:00")
- `pricing` (PricingTier[] | null, optional) - Array of pricing tiers with label, amount, and optional note
- `performers` (Performer[] | null, optional) - Array of performers with name, optional role, and optional instagramHandle
- `hashtags` (string[] | null, optional) - Array of hashtags (without # prefix)

**Related Type Files:**

```typescript
events = pgTable("events", {
  id: text().primaryKey(),

  description: text(),
  thumbnail: text(),
  type: eventTypeEnum().notNull(),
  isPickup: boolean().notNull().default(false),
  openTime: varchar({ length: 5 }).notNull(),
  startTime: varchar({ length: 5 }).notNull(),
  pricing: jsonb(),
  performers: jsonb(),
  hashtags: text().array(),
})
```
